composer.disclaimer: The assistant can make mistakes. Verify important information.

consultant.title: Consultant assistant
consultant.description: Your copilot across the whole portfolio: analyse clients, projects and processes, and line up the next steps.
prompts: Summarise the status of at-risk projects
Which decisions are waiting on me?
Draft the agenda for the next steering committee
Open a new project for a client

project.title: Project chat
project.description: Reason across the whole project: progress, processes in scope, risks and open decisions.
prompts: List the processes in scope and their readiness
Generate the management summary for the sponsor

process.title: Process chat
process.description: Work on this process: AS-IS evidence, roles, exceptions and the handoff to the BPMN model.
prompts: Summarise the evidence gathered so far
What information is missing to model the process?
List roles and exceptions still to confirm
Prepare the brief to generate the BPMN

canvas.title: Canvas chat
canvas.description: Edit the BPMN model in words: the assistant updates the diagram and checks it stays consistent.
prompts: Generate the BPMN from the process evidence
Add a gateway after the credit check
Assign an owner role to every activity
Validate the coverage of roles and exceptions
